project.job: New Dwelling, Plot 1 Rivendell Park, Douglas
project.model_title: ES26-084 New Dwelling, Plot 1 Rivendell Park, Douglas - Quotation Q01

views.title: Pool tank
views.desc: ICF pool tank in Nudura 10in Standard (3 courses, 3.9 x 9.8 m inside, ~1.5 m deep - assumed) on a 300 RC base (indicative - pool specialist / engineer).

views.title: Basement
views.desc: Basement raft (BS 8102 Type B, indicative) and the 10in Standard basement walls, 8 courses to the ground floor, cores on the same centre lines as the house above; garage door, pool windows, laundry door; TLSTF basement partitions.

views.title: Ground floor slab and master suite footing
views.desc: GF suspended RC slab over the basement and pool hall (engineer), the 6in XR35 footing (2 courses) and ground-bearing floor of the master suite.

views.title: Ground floor ICF, partitions and glazing
views.desc: Ground-floor 6in XR35 walls (14 courses) with the gables raked to the roof, the floor-length windows, bi-folds and the RAKED feature glazing to the gables / under the roof slopes; TLSTF partitions raked to the vaulted ceilings.

views.title: Vaulted roof structure
views.desc: Vaulted roofs with a structural ridge: 63x220 C24 rafters @600, Roof L ridge 120x400 GL24h glulam on three 100x100 SHS posts in the wing partitions, Roof R 140x800 GL24h glulam ridge (indicative - engineer).
